R2286.name: octanoyl-[ACP]:H-protein N-octanoyltransferase, mitochondrial (LIP2-type)
R2286.evidence: Lip2 is required for lipoylation of Lat1, Kgd2 and Gcv3 in S. cerevisiae (Schonauer et al. 2009). YALI1F34729g: 30% identity / 84% query coverage to Lip2 (Q06005). Reciprocity is family-level only: the reverse top hits are LipB-family octanoyltransferases (S. pombe O36017 first, a bacterial LipB second, K. lactis O13476 third); S. cerevisiae Lip2 is not among the top five. Not on the consensus essential list (Cas9 essential q 0.0023, Cas12a nonessential q 0.68). Octanoyl is placed on the H-protein first by analogy to the Rhea/B. subtilis route; the yeast step order is not established. Returns ACP1 in the mitochondrion.

R2287.name: lipoyl synthase, mitochondrial (LIP5, lumped sulfur and electron donors)
R2287.evidence: Lip5 is required for lipoylation in S. cerevisiae (Schonauer et al. 2009). YALI1E13472g: 70% identity / 82% coverage to Lip5 (P32875); reverse top hit Swiss-Prot Q6C6C6 LIPA_YARLI (100%; PE3, HAMAP-inferred, the same protein in strain CLIB122, so not independent identity evidence). Rhea 16585 writes the dihydrolipoyl-protein product, 2 SAM to 2 Met + 2 5'-deoxyadenosine, with an auxiliary [4Fe-4S] cluster as sulfur source (released as 2 hydrogen sulfide + 4 Fe3+) and ferredoxin. Lumped here: the 2 inserted sulfur atoms as L-cysteine to L-alanine (cysteine desulfurase) and the electrons as NADPH. The chemistry needs 2 NADPH (4 electrons) with ChEBI charges; it is written as 4 NADPH because the model's NADP(+) (m178, C21H29N7O17P3) carries charge 0, so each NADPH to NADP(+) releases one H here. Written charge-balanced.

R2288.name: LIP3-dependent lipoylation of E2 lipoyl domains, mitochondrial (lumped; mechanism unresolved)
R2288.evidence: Lip3 and lipoylated Gcv3 are required for Lat1 and Kgd2 lipoylation in S. cerevisiae (Schonauer et al. 2009). Mechanism unresolved: Hermes and Cronan 2013 found Lip3 octanoyl-CoA:protein transferase activity but no amidotransfer and no ligase activity in vitro, and proposed that Lip3 octanoylates PDH and OGDH from octanoyl-CoA downstream of Gcv3 lipoylation; UniProt P47051 is PE3, a putative lipoate-protein ligase. This reaction lumps E2 lipoylation as transfer of the lipoyl moiety made on the H-protein; per E2 lipoyl the net cost (one mtFAS octanoyl and two sulfur insertions) is the same under both proposed mechanisms. No EC or Rhea identifier is asserted. YALI1C04991g: 37% identity / 70% coverage to Lip3/AIM22 (P47051); reverse top hits LPLA S. pombe and S. cerevisiae. YALI1E00574g (GCV3 ortholog, 39%/98%, reverse top hit GCSH_YEAST) is AND-ed because lipoylated Gcv3 is required. One pooled E2 lipoyl-domain species stands for Lat1 and Kgd2, and it is not connected to the PDH or OGDH reactions.

R2289.name: L-cysteine transport, cytosol to mitochondrion (ASSUMPTION)
R2289.evidence: ASSUMPTION: supplies the lipoyl synthase sulfur donor; no mitochondrial cysteine transporter is assigned and none was reviewed. Unidirectional.

R2290.name: 5'-deoxyadenosine sink, mitochondrion (ASSUMPTION)
R2290.evidence: ASSUMPTION: 5'-deoxyadenosine from lipoyl synthase has no salvage route in the model; this labelled sink removes it. Its flux equals 2 x the lipoyl synthase flux.
